notes: Disposable 2.5 lb unit that Kidde's spec sheet (part 21010207) describes with an aluminium cylinder and nylon valve, handle and lever. Kidde's page for the FA110G, a different SKU, shows a metal valve, and CPSC recall 15-079 (2015) names the FA110 with plastic valves only for units made 23 July 2013 to 15 October 2014, so check the valve on the unit in hand.

gaps: Valve and handle material conflict: the spec sheet says nylon valve, handle and lever; the Kidde FA110G page has an image caption 'metal valve and painted metal handles & cylinder' and text saying aluminum construction. The FA110G is a different SKU, so the spec sheet is kept for the FA110.
Size: 3.25 in diameter and 13.75 in high on the spec sheet; the FA110G page gives 14.2 x 4.65 in without saying which is which.
SKU: the spec sheet is part 21010207, labelled Model FA110; the Kidde web page is for model FA110G. Check which SKU a unit carries.

CPSC recall 15-079 (12 February 2015) lists the FA110 among 31 disposable models with black Zytel plastic valves, covering units made 23 July 2013 to 15 October 2014 by date code; it does not say what valve other units have.

Dry chemical and the expellant are not recorded as components: no part type fits. Kidde's commercial ABC safety data sheet (2023-10-20) lists monoammonium phosphate 45-70% and compressed air as the expellant, but covers Kidde commercial ABC in general, not the FA110 by name.
Discharge time (8 to 12 s) and range (6 to 8 ft) are on the spec sheet but are not components.
Gauge range, safety pin and bracket materials are not given in the sources read, so the sheet_metal key for the bracket is the record's category.
method: Kidde Recreational Fire Extinguisher spec sheet, part 21010207, Model FA110 (Kidde Fire Safety, Mebane NC; PDF on media.distributordatasolutions.com, undated, URL path suggests a 2016 Q4 upload).
Kidde FA110G product page on kidde.com, read through WebFetch (text is partly image captions): used for the valve conflict and size only.
Kidde Commercial ABC Dry Chemical SDS, issued 2023-10-20, copy on wcponline.wcpsolutions.com: used for the gaps only.
CPSC recall 15-079 page on cpsc.gov: used for the notes and gaps only.

comps.spec: Seamless aluminium cylinder, disposable, 3.25 in diameter and 13.75 in high; net agent weight 2.5 lb (average), unit weight 3.9 lb (average)
Nylon valve assembly; the spec sheet lists valve, handle and lever as nylon
Pressure gauge that shows at a glance whether the unit is charged; the spec sheet gives an operating pressure of 100 psi
Easy-to-pull safety pin, listed as a feature on the spec sheet
Strap retention bracket 896698R, supplied with the unit; the spec sheet calls it UL approved, and Coast Guard approved when the unit is fitted with it
